current_source.description: ⭐ Join Wolt as a Part-Time English & Georgian Speaking Support Associate! ⭐ Are you a great communicator? Do you enjoy working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment? Earn extra income while building professional skills in a part-time role. 📈 Looking for something more? Join us full-time and become part of a team that invests in your growth, development, and long-term success. 🚀 Grow with us Start your journey today and explore future opportunities as your career develops. 💙 What You’ll Be Doing Assisting customers, courier partners, and venues across multiple countries via live chat and phone Helping ensure smooth and efficient delivery operations Working closely with the support team and other Wolt teams to continuously improve our service 🌟 What We’re Looking For You don’t need previous customer service experience - we’ll train you! Are you a strong communicator? Do you thrive in a dynamic environment? Love helping people and solving problems? If your answer is yes , then this opportunity might be perfect for you! 🤩 ​​We’re looking for full-time (40 hrs/week) Support Associates who are fluent in Georgian and have professional working proficiency in English (B2+), both written and spoken. You'll join our remote support team as part of our Shared Service Center, supporting multiple Wolt countries around the world. 🌏 Grow with one of the world's fastest-growing tech companies. Build your skills, expand your experience, and be part of a team that invests in your success. 🚀 Build a career, not just experience. Join a global team where you'll develop valuable skills, grow professionally, and make an impact from day one. ✨Your next opportunity starts here. Join a team that values growth, collaboration, and helping people succeed every step of the way. What You’ll Be Doing💙 Assisting customers, courier partners, and venues across multiple countries via live chat and phone Helping ensure smooth and efficient delivery operations Growing your skills while working with teams across Wolt to improve our support operations What We’re Looking For🌟 No previous customer service experience? No problem! We’ll teach you everything you need to know. If you do have experience, that’s a bonus - but not a requirement. We’d love to meet you if you: Are a clear and empathetic communicator with a naturally customer-focused approach; Learn new things quickly and feel comfortable handling multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment; Have availability to work 5 days per week across different shift types, including mornings, evenings, and weekends, as our operation runs 24/7; Have written and spoken fluency in Georgian and have professional working proficiency in English; Work well independently and feel comfortable in a remote environment What You’ll Get by Joining Us 🎁 Medical insurance 24 paid vacation days 🌴 Wolt credits cashback benefit Sports discounts 🚴 Wolt-wide learning and development opportunities A supportive, collaborative, and fast-growing environment where you can build your career 📈 Ready to Apply?🚀 If you're excited about learning fast, making an impact and being part of a driven, global team - we'd love to hear from you! 👉 No CV needed - just submit your online application. Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .
